chunks: And from him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) fasted on the day of Ashura.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad fast on the day of Ashura?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the Prophet's voluntary fasting on the tenth of Muharram, a practice he continued after migrating to Medina to align with the Jewish tradition. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as the foundational evidence for the recommended (mustahabb) status of fasting on Ashura, distinct from the obligatory fast of Ramadan, highlighting its role in spiritual purification and gratitude.
